g.text: Nobody ever asks how much water

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: The entitlement pathway, and the year each building's approval was granted

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Data centers are permitted by right inside the Data Center Opportunity Overlay District; a SUP is triggered only by exceeding the by-right

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: envelope (height or floor-area ratio), never by the use itself. Where the approval predates the industry no water condition could have been

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: contemplated, and an entitlement runs with the land. Where a data-center SUP does exist in the county record — Amazon Gainesville East —

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: water quality was charged at $4,390 against $791,292 for fire and rescue, a factor of 180, while a licensed acoustical study of the cooling system was required twice per building.
